segments.name: Community banking
segments.description: A community bank offering commercial, real estate and consumer loans, deposit and payment services, insurance, brokerage, fiduciary and trust services to consumers and businesses.
segments.evidence: Peoples' business activities are currently limited to one reporting unit and reportable operating segment, which is community banking.

revenueModel.text: Peoples earns interest on loans and leases retained on its balance sheet, plus fee income from services such as overdrafts, insurance, premium financing and equipment financing.
revenueModel.evidence: In general, Peoples Bank retains the majority of the loans and leases it originates; however, certain longer-term fixed-rate mortgage loan originations, primarily one-to-four family residential mortgage loans, and portions of select commercial real estate loans and commercial and industrial loans are sold into the secondary market or to other financial institutions.
